subject: pathology
title: Pneumoconioses and environmental lung disease

steps.tx: **Pneumoconioses** are lung fibroses from inhaled inorganic dusts retained over years of occupational exposure: coal, silica and asbestos archetypically. Fibre or particle shape, durability and dose decide pathogenicity, and disease may progress after exposure ends. Occupational history is therefore a diagnostic test no imaging replaces.
steps.say: Dust fibroses lungs over occupational years and may progress after exposure stops. Job history diagnoses what scans only suggest. Coal, silica and asbestos lead.

steps.tx: **Silicosis** from quartz in mining, stone cutting and sandblasting fibroses upper lobes with small nodules, hilar eggshell calcification and progressive massive fibrosis conglomerates in heavy exposure. Silica cripples macrophage killing so tuberculosis activates readily (silicotuberculosis) and autoimmune diseases associate. Acute silicoproteinosis follows massive sandblasting exposure within months like alveolar proteinosis.
steps.say: Silica scars upper lobes with eggshell nodes and invites tuberculosis inside macrophages it cripples. Massive acute exposure floods alveoli protein like.

vis.alt: Chest CT showing silicosis with upper lobe nodules, hilar eggshell calcification, and progressive massive fibrosis.
vis.caption: Silicosis: Nodules, eggshell calcification, PMF

steps.tx: **Asbestosis** fibroses lower lobes subpleurally with pleural plaques, thickening and effusions as exposure receipts, while malignancy risks (lung cancer multiplied by smoking, mesothelioma decades later) exceed fibrosis burden in importance. Ferruginous asbestos bodies on biopsy prove exposure, not necessarily disease causation of every lesion found.
steps.say: Asbestos scars lower lobes and pleura, but cancers matter more: lung multiplied by smoking, mesothelioma after decades. Plaques receipt the exposure.

steps.tx: **Coal workers pneumoconiosis** ranges from simple black macules with little impairment in most miners to progressive massive fibrosis with disabling restriction and cor pulmonale in a minority, without silica eggshell pattern unless mixed dust. Caplan syndrome adds rheumatoid necrobiotic nodules erupting in pneumoconiotic lungs of rheumatoid patients.
steps.say: Coal blackens lungs mildly in most, massively fibroses few. Rheumatoid lungs erupt Caplan nodules over dust. Simple disease reassures; massive disables.

steps.tx: **Hypersensitivity pneumonitis** is immune (not inorganic fibrosis) alveolitis from organic antigens: farmer lung (mouldy hay), bird fancier (avian proteins), hot tub lung (mycobacteria). Acute episodes fever and breathlessness hours after exposure, chronic disease fibroses upper and mid zones with mosaic attenuation, and antigen avoidance is both diagnostic trial and treatment.
steps.say: Organic antigens inflame alveoli immunologically: farmer, bird and hot tub lungs. Acute attacks follow exposure by hours. Avoidance treats and proves it.
